title: AegisVox: Factorized Privacy and Clinical Preservation for Long-Form Speech
authors: Praphul Singh, Akshat Agarwal, Ratul Ghosh, Aashna Kanuga, Devashish Khatwani, Anurag Dwarakanath, Sri Gadde, Krishnaram Kenthapadi
label: Speech & privacy
summary: Separating voice identity and spoken identifiers to examine the tradeoffs between speech privacy and clinical preservation.
abstract: A factorized framework uses consistent surrogate voices and identifier replacements. Matched renderer comparisons examine replacement realization, speaker linkage, and clinical preservation separately, showing why stronger performance on one measure need not improve the others.

title: ContractEval: Query-Conditioned Execution Matching for Procedural Instruction Conformance
authors: Praphul Singh, Shanu Kumar, Akshat Agarwal, Ganesh Kumar
label: Agents & evaluation
summary: Making an agent’s procedural obligations explicit, so plausible answers cannot hide skipped checks or incorrect execution paths.
abstract: Query-active obligations are matched against responses and execution traces to localize omissions, branch errors, ordering failures, and contract violations. Procedural conformance is treated as a distinct diagnostic target rather than assumed from final-answer quality.

title: Beyond Endpoint Gains: A Weight-Delta Audit of Medical Specialization
authors: Praphul Singh, Shanu Kumar, Akshat Agarwal
label: Model understanding
summary: Examining what a specialist model’s parameter update explains—and what aggregate benchmark gains leave unresolved.
abstract: Paired generalist-to-specialist checkpoint audits distinguish reconstructing benchmark movement from explaining it. Component-family interventions and matched controls test whether gains can be attributed to a particular part of the released weight update.
figure_alt: Paired model checkpoint and weight-delta audit
